capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: UNPROVEN pack for the 2025 SUV 3X (OWNER QUESTION): no page gives it. Basis: the 2025 pickup 3X carries NRCan's label "(20M Battery)"; the SUV 3X has no such label but its EPA range (502.1 km) equals the pickup 3X, and The Charge Port (2026 page) lists the SUV 3X at 300 kW, the 20-module level. 20-module pack c. 170 kWh (Wikipedia; Weekly Driver as published).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Same GM Ultium NCMA cells as the 24-module pack (Weekly Driver); closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: GM TechLink: ~400 V per layer, layers switched in series for "800-volt DC fast charging". Treated as the 800 V class (as the Silverado EV 24- and 20-module records). The 20-module pack is assumed to use the same switching (The Charge Port: "800V DC charging up to 300 kW" on the 2X).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: GM's battery-preconditioning guide (chevrolet.com returns 403, search excerpt only): automatic with Google built-in navigation plus a manual Fast Charge Prep in the app; applied lineup-wide to GM Ultium vehicles as for Silverado EV/Equinox EV records. UNVERIFIED on a page for this model. GM TechLink (2022 Hummer) says the apps can precondition the battery for charging; automatic navigation-based preconditioning from the GM guide assumed for the 2024-2025 trucks.

dc_max_kw.notes: The Charge Port: "800V DC charging up to 300 kW" (Pickup 2X); 300 kW is also the 20-module Silverado EV figure (GM spec guide).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: The Charge Port: home charging up to 19.2 kW (about 80 A); Wikipedia 19.2 kW. No page separates the 2X/20-module AC rating; 19.2 kW assumed (an 11.5 kW standard charger as on the Silverado EV is possible).
